content:
id: vision_comstar_voice
description: >
  Ada vision MCP — live camera frames via CodeProject.AI, plus Frigate visitor
  history (recognized faces and descriptions of unknowns).
capabilities: >
  who_is_present, describe_view, check_camera, who_visited, list_person_visits,
  describe_visit against Frigate/CPAI.
good_for: >
  who is at the front door, describe the camera, what do you see,
  who was in the driveway, visitors today, who came by
planner_hint: >
  Attach for camera/scene and visitor-history questions. Use who_visited for
  "who was in the driveway today". Not for "who's home" (use HA presence).
  Not for hallway session identity (Pi face poller).
user_goal_keywords:
  - front door
  - who is at the door
  - describe the camera
  - what do you see
  - check the camera
  - who's outside
  - driveway
  - who was in the driveway
  - visitors today
  - who came by
  - unrecognized
  - someone in the driveway

content:
  file: vision_comstar_voice/instructions.md

inject:
  target: backstory
  heading: "## Vision camera (voice)"
  max_chars: 1600
